name: The European Side
overview: The life and times of rather traditional Sutcuoglu family and their comedic struggles to adapt the high-profile contemporary life of Nisantasi.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Aslı is now 30 years old and Aslı's mother İffet is trying to marry her off but Aslı does not like her mother's candidates. Aslı's biggest suitor is Tacettin, the son of a family friend, who thinks he is Aslı's betrothed after several attempts to ask for the girl's hand in marriage. Aslı is also in love with their new general manager Cem and his love is not unrequited. Volkan is also looking for ways to become famous and for this purpose he evaluates the projects of his best friend Sertaç. At the same time, he is trying to seduce Selin, who has entered Aslı's office as the boss's daughter. Yaprak, who likes Volkan's macho attitude very much, has also fallen in love with Volkan. Selin, who is jealous of Yaprak getting closer to Volkan, is also getting closer to Volkan day by day. The mother and father of the Sütçüoğlu family, İffet and Tahsin, are also not happy with these two bride candidates.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Volkan tries to choose between Yaprak and Selin but remains undecided. On the other hand, Tacettin comes to ask for Aslı. Seeing this, Cem cannot stand Tacettin's insult and wants the girl. Tahsin Bey chooses Cem. Volkan finally decides to marry Selin. However, as a result of the mishaps that developed in the season finale, Volkan gives up on marrying Selin. In the meantime, a love affair begins between Volkan's ex-girlfriend Yaprak and Selin's ex-girlfriend Kubilay, while Volkan begins to climb the stairs of fame rapidly.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The third season began airing on September 14, 2005 and ended on June 21, 2006. In the 3rd season, which consisted of 36 episodes, Aslı and Cem got married towards the end, Volkan was arrested for being a draft dodger and went to Trabzon to do his military service, and Burhan Altıntop, the new managing director of the magazine, moved into the lower floor of the Sütçüoğlu flat as a tenant.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The fourth season was broadcast on September 13, 2006 and took a break on June 27, 2007. In this season, Makbule and Sacit, who came from Gaziantep, settled in the apartment next to the Sütçüoğlu residence, Fatoş and Tanrıverdi, who worked as a tea maker in the magazine office, started a love affair, Yaprak and Kubilay got married. A total of 38 episodes were shot in the fourth season and a break was taken at the 130th episode.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: The fifth season was broadcast on September 19, 2007 and ended on June 4, 2008 with its 162nd episode. A total of 32 episodes were produced in the 5th season and the relationships between Makbule and Burhan, Aslı and Osman, and Sacit and Şahika were discussed.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: The sixth season of the series was broadcasted on ATV on September 24, 2008. In the season where Binnur Kaya played two characters (Aunt Dilber and Sahika), Ifo went to Bursa. Aunt Dilber, who moved to the Sütçüoğlu apartment, started to get close to Mr. Tahsin. This continued until the death of Gazanfer Özcan, who played Uncle Tahsin. Therefore, Müşfik Kenter and Gönül Ülkü, who played the role of Makbule's mother and father, joined the cast. And Ata Demirer started to play two characters like Binnur Kaya. His other character is Azim. In the 6th season, Volkan's return from military service, the love between Sahika and Volkan, Burhan's escape from Makbule, and the relationship between Osman and Aslı are discussed. The series said goodbye to the screens in the 190th episode.
